newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't coffee auction to total 30,000 bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't coffee auction to total 30,000 bags.

text.p: Brazil's government will auction 30,000 60-kg bags of its coffee stocks on September 25, said a Banco do Brasil spokesman.
The auction will take place at 1400 local/1700 GMT. Some 10,000 bags are warehoused in Parana. Sao Paulo warehouses have 10,114 bags and Minas Gerais warehoused the remaining 9,886 bags.
The coffee to be put up for auction comes from harvests ranging from 1982/83 to 1993/94.
The auction, open to exporters, domestic roasters and the soluble coffee industry, is the third of a series of monthly auctions to be held throughout the coffee year (July/June).
The limit of each auction is 200,000 bags but the actual quantity of each sale should reflect the supply situation prevailing at the time.
Given tha fact the 1996/97 coffee harvest is well underway, traders had not expected a large quantity to be put up for sale this month. The next auction is slated to October 23, the spokesman said.
